authorized_scope: Exactly 3 fixed schedules by 3 seeds; final VF diagnostic, no model reselection or test-based tuning.
precision: FP32; frozen source float32 data and model, no autocast/scaler; do not add ignored precision configuration keys

comparisons.primary: Matched-seed validation NRMSE LR1-LR0 and LR2-LR0; show every run, means and sample SD, no model reselection.
comparisons.secondary: Validation NMAE/R2, best epoch, epochs completed, all validation trajectories, observed first-batch gradient cosines and complete child wallclock.
comparisons.interpretation: LR1 isolates Stage-3 rate; LR2 jointly changes pretraining rates, not separate Stage-1/2 effects. Gradient cosine is a function of sampled batch/weights/loss support; the scalar LR does not directly rotate the gradient.
comparisons.inference: Three paired seeds give limited power; descriptive results and paired differences primary, no equivalence or optimality claim.

test_policy: selection_scope validation exports only val_predictions.npz and validation metrics; frozen trainer still saves an unlabeled first-test input latency sample, not test performance. No test selection, no revised main model.
failure_policy: Preserve partial files and logs; stop on any child/strict-artifact failure; no automatic retries or duplicate completed training.
runner_policy: One native locked serial runner per machine; same seed stays on same hardware; verify PID/create_time/cmd/cwd and GPU occupancy; LR0 is newly trained with own identity.
